name: wordkeep-reminders
description: Dependencies for tools/send-reminders.mjs only. The app itself has no build step and no dependencies. Versions are exact and package-lock.json pins everything underneath them: this job holds the Firebase service account and the VAPID private key, so it must never run a release nobody has looked at. To upgrade, change the version here, run `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` in tools/, run the script once without secrets (it should stop at 'missing VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY'), and commit both files.
